hero.description: The enterprise operations platform for organizations managing complex workflows across multiple departments. Automate approvals, control budgets, track resources, manage documents, and get real-time operational visibility — all from a single command center.

capabilities.title: Everything Your Organization Needs. All in One Place.
capabilities.subtitle: A modular platform covering every department — workflows, resources, supply chain, compliance, and financial control — with role-based access for every level of your organization.

workflow.title: Workflow & Approval Engine
workflow.description: Design and deploy multi-step approval chains for any department. Any process — requisitions, budget allocations, document sign-offs — can be modelled, versioned, and fully audited end-to-end.

fleet.title: Resource & Operations Management
fleet.description: Manage physical assets, scheduling, and assignments across departments. Track utilization, maintenance records, and operational costs in real time.

compliance.title: Compliance & Audit Trail
compliance.description: Every action is timestamped and immutably logged. Full GDPR-compliant audit history for document access, approvals, and operational decisions — ready for inspection at any time.

supplyChain.title: Supply Chain & Inventory
supplyChain.description: Automate requisitions, track stock movements, and trigger reorders based on configurable rules. Complete traceability from supplier to point of use.

budget.title: Budget Execution & BI
budget.description: Cross-department financial dashboards, automated execution reports, and KPI tracking — real-time visibility into operational spend versus budget targets.

precisionInMotion.title: Every Request. Tracked, Approved, and Documented.
precisionInMotion.description: Every operation across your organization follows a controlled, auditable path. LogiCore enforces the right steps in the right order — so nothing falls through the cracks.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.s1p1: LogiCore (we, us, or our) is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our enterprise resource planning platform and associated services.
privacyPolicy.s1p2: By accessing or using LogiCore, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. If you do not agree with the terms, please discontinue use of the platform.
privacyPolicy.s2intro: We may collect the following categories of personal data:
privacyPolicy.s2i1: Account information — name, email address, job title, company name, and password hash.
privacyPolicy.s2i2: Usage data — IP addresses, browser type, pages visited, time spent, and interaction logs.
privacyPolicy.s2i3: Operational data — fleet records, approval workflows, document metadata, and budget entries you create within the platform.
privacyPolicy.s2i4: Communication data — messages sent via the contact form or support channels.
privacyPolicy.s3intro: We use the collected data to:
privacyPolicy.s3i1: Provide, maintain, and improve the LogiCore platform.
privacyPolicy.s3i2: Authenticate users and manage access permissions.
privacyPolicy.s3i3: Send transactional notifications (e.g., approval updates, system alerts).
privacyPolicy.s3i4: Analyse usage patterns to enhance platform performance and user experience.
privacyPolicy.s3i5: Comply with legal obligations under Romanian and EU law.
privacyPolicy.s4p1: If you are located in the European Economic Area, we process your personal data under the following legal bases: contractual necessity, legitimate interests, compliance with legal obligations, and, where required, your explicit consent.
privacyPolicy.s5p1: We retain personal data for as long as your account is active or as required to provide services. Operational records may be retained for up to 7 years to comply with Romanian accounting and audit regulations. You may request deletion of your data at any time, subject to applicable legal retention requirements.
privacyPolicy.s6p1: We do not sell your personal data. We may share data with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating the platform (e.g., cloud hosting, analytics), under strict data processing agreements. We may also disclose data if required by law or to protect the rights of LogiCore or its users.
privacyPolicy.s7p1: We implement industry-standard security measures including TLS encryption in transit, AES-256 encryption at rest, role-based access control, and regular security audits. No method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure; we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your data.
privacyPolicy.s8intro: Under GDPR and applicable Romanian law, you have the right to:
privacyPolicy.s8i1: Access the personal data we hold about you.
privacyPolicy.s8i3: Request erasure (right to be forgotten) where legally permissible.
privacyPolicy.s8i4: Object to or restrict certain types of processing.
privacyPolicy.s8i5: Receive your data in a portable format.
privacyPolicy.s8i6: Lodge a complaint with the Romanian National Supervisory Authority (ANSPDCP).
privacyPolicy.s9p1: For any privacy-related inquiries or to exercise your rights, please contact our Data Protection Officer at
